title: New sub: DreamSpaces
content: Hi! Since TheMallWorld is more related to Malls, I decided to create a new group just for dream locations we visit. Give it a look, but be advised that I only have a few posts. I need your help to grow up :) [https://www.reddit.com/r/DreamSpaces/](https://www.reddit.com/r/DreamSpaces/)
